critique: The tester successfully isolated and reproduced a critical pipeline hazard bug in the Zacas extension implementation. The core issue lies in src/ieu/controller.sv and src/ieu/datapath.sv: the hazard detection and forwarding logic completely ignore the implicitly written `rd+1` destination register of `amocas` (when used in its paired form, amocas.d/q). Pipeline registers RdEReg, RdMReg, and RdWReg only latch the base destination `rd`. As a result, MatchDE fails to detect Decode-stage RAW hazards on `rd+1`, and the Execute-stage forwarding paths for SrcAE and SrcBE lack any capability to bypass ReadDataHighW. Consequently, dependent instructions that read `rd+1` without sufficient pipeline distance fetch stale uncommitted data from the register file (since writes only commit on the negedge clk of the Writeback stage). The provided reproducer deterministically tests this with an immediate consumer of `rd+1`, proving the mismatch against the Spike oracle. The provided tests and reproduction script conform perfectly to the required workspace hygiene and execution protocols.
